title: Shu Hu 胡书
content: I am a PhD student in the Department of Microbiology, School of Life Sciences, Fudan University, with an expected graduation date of June 2029. My research combines AI foundation models, biological sequence representation learning and deep learning with viral evolution and genomic epidemiology. My experience includes nucleotide foundation-model benchmarking, protein language-model applications, computational model development and evaluation, and bioinformatics analysis workflows.
summary: 我现为复旦大学生命科学学院微生物系博士研究生，预计于2029年6月毕业。研究结合AI大模型与基础模型、生物序列表征学习及深度学习，关注病毒进化与基因组流行病学。研究经历涵盖核酸基础模型评测、蛋白质语言模型应用、计算模型开发与评估，以及生物信息学分析流程构建。
